description:
Reads an iOS app from its App Store link or id and says what Pagefully understood of it. Call this first.
Signed in (OAuth or a Pagefully token): adds the app to the workspace (no App Store Connect key is needed to plan and make pages) and returns the app, with its app_id, its brief (what the app does, who it is for and how it sounds) and its screens. "screens" is the app's own source screenshots as Pagefully holds them, in order: each with its position, its picture at display size (url), and what Pagefully read on it (read: the headline and subline the developer drew on it, and "design", which is "theirs" for a designed screenshot a page keeps and only rewords, or "ours" for a bare screen a page puts in Pagefully's own design). Compare a page against these, not against another page. An app that is not on the public App Store says so in app.listing.note, with where its facts came from: repeat that sentence, and do not look the app up elsewhere. Reading a new app takes a while, so the first call may return a job_id and no brief: call get_job with it until it is done, then call analyze_app again with app_id. Called with app_id it only reads. Called with nothing it lists the apps on the workspace.
Not signed in: returns the free public preview of that app, the pages Pagefully would plan for it and the first one designed, with a preview_url. While state is "making", call again with the same app in a few seconds. This works on public App Store data only and is limited for each visitor.
Show the person the brief (or the preview_url) and ask whether it is right before planning. Never guess an App Store id: ask for the link.

app_id.description: The app's id in Pagefully, for an app already on the workspace. Reads only.

app_store_id.description: Apple's id for the app: the number at the end of its App Store address.

app_store_url.description: The app's address on the App Store, which ends in id and a number: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/name/id1234567890

screens.description: false leaves the app's source screens out of the answer.

name: analyze_app
title: Analyze an app
